summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the voting results from its annual shareholders meeting held June 12, 2026. The report details the election of eight director nominees, the reappointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation, all of which passed with overwhelming shareholder support. 72,780,231 common shares (50.77% of outstanding) were represented. There is no special-situation event; this is a routine periodic disclosure of meeting outcomes with no corporate action, bid, or restructuring involved.
